name: KnowStack
description: Native long-term project memory: durable facts, repository and conversation indexes, evidenced updates and opt-in autonomous deletion.
author: KnowStack

en.name: KnowStack
en.description: Reusable project facts and knowledge indexes in native memory, with always-available updates and opt-in autonomous deletion.
en.safetyNotes: Auto-save defaults ON; model deletion defaults OFF and is independently controlled per project. Evidence-based updates are always available. Uses the native store only, fixed trusted Renderer channels, snapshot checks and read-back. No network, database access, host edits or elevated session permissions. Whole-list native saves are not atomic across other windows. The docked view uses the ordinary ui.view permission and requires a normal reload/grant on first upgrade.

zh-CN.name: 知栈 · KnowStack
zh-CN.description: 原生长期项目记忆：仓库与约束、稳定决策、会话索引；支持按 ID 修改和可关闭的模型自主删除。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 自动保存默认开启，模型自主删除默认关闭，可按项目控制；有证据的原条目修改始终可用。只用原生记忆与固定 Renderer 通道，不联网、不读写数据库、不改宿主、不申请更广会话权限。写入先比对快照、后回读，但宿主整表保存不能保证跨窗口原子性。内嵌侧栏声明普通 ui.view 权限，首次升级需正常 reload 并由宿主确认，不绕过授权。

agentTools.name: read_memory
agentTools.description: Read current native long-term project memory at the START of EVERY user turn and again before writing. Returns entries, a same-session/same-turn readToken valid for 5 minutes, autoSave and autoDelete. Reuse stable facts, repository/constraint and conversation indexes, not temporary progress. Failure is not empty memory.

agentTools.name: remember
agentTools.description: At the END of EVERY user turn save only genuinely new reusable project facts: verified repository URLs, durable constraints, stable decisions, or conversation topic plus a verified lookup location. No progress logs, routine test results or temporary paths. Deduplicate semantically using a fresh readToken. autoSave ON saves directly; OFF requires real user review. Corrections use update_memory. Never retry unverified writes.

agentTools.name: report_outdated_memory
agentTools.description: After the start-of-turn memory check or new evidence during the task, report 1–3 possibly obsolete entries with concrete evidence and a valid same-session/same-turn readToken. Reminder only: users inspect and manually delete; NEVER modify memory, even with auto-save ON. Age or non-use alone is not evidence. Respect duplicates. On status reported append finalReminder verbatim to the FINAL answer outside code fences to show the reminder card.

agentTools.name: update_memory
agentTools.description: Update 1–3 existing native memories by ID when verified project facts change. Always available, no switch, independent of autoSave. Requires fresh same-session/same-turn readToken, title, concise complete content and evidence. Keep the ID and still-valid conditions. Never blank a memory to bypass deletion; do not retry an unverified write.

agentTools.name: delete_memory
agentTools.description: Autonomously delete 1–3 proven obsolete native memories by ID ONLY when the project's autoDelete switch is ON. Requires fresh same-session/same-turn readToken, specific reason and concrete evidence. Changed facts should be updated, not deleted. Age/non-use is not evidence. OFF: report_outdated_memory for user review; never enable the switch or simulate clicks. Wait for verified deleted receipt; never retry an unverified write.

settings.title: 默认自动保存项目记忆
settings.description: 仅保存长期可复用的新知识；已有项目选择不变。关闭后可人工确认保存。

settings.title: 默认允许模型删除记忆
settings.description: 新项目默认值；已有项目独立控制。开启后模型可依据证据删除明确失效条目，不影响手动删除或始终可用的修改。
